title: nothing asserts the declared version has been released
desc:
wb task clean shipped under 0.5.0 with no version bump, so /plugin compared 0.5.0 against 0.5.0, reported 'already at the latest version' and left the installed copy on four wb task actions. test_plugin.py:216 asserts the package version and both manifests agree with each other; nothing asserts the declared version is a released one.

ACCEPTANCE:
- a test fails when CHANGELOG.md has no '## <__version__>' section
- the same test fails when that section is still marked unreleased
- the failure message says what to do (bump, or mark the section released)
